baselineType: pre-fix deterministic Runtime baseline; not real-provider user task completion rate

audit.initialRetrievalIntent: Derived from trusted inbound user text/classification in packages/harness/src/retrieval-intent.ts.
audit.modelVisibleCatalog: Stable registered catalog; visibility is not execution authorization.
audit.priorR01Failure: main-loop supplied the frozen admittedTools set; tool-loop refused Web before ToolExecutionService when initial intent was local.
audit.dynamicAdmission: Per requested call only: built-in web_search/web_fetch, enabled non-disabled resolved run network policy, no explicit trusted-user offline denial, and no narrower explicit tool allowlist.
audit.executionPath: Ordinary ToolExecutionService -> built-in Web tool -> authorizeToolAccess -> host-owned WebRetrievalRuntime.
audit.trustedPolicyOwner: Runner resolves a run-scoped immutable network policy; explicit offline user instruction hard-disables it. Main permission broker and Web tools retain existing approval and data-boundary decisions.
audit.externalContent: Web evidence remains externalUntrusted; page/model text does not set user policy or expand other tool permissions.
audit.notImplemented: No new Harness loop or permission manager; no Shell, side-effect-ledger, VERIFY, or release workflow changes.

R01.executionLayer: Harness Execute + ToolExecutionService + built-in web_search + loopback HTTP fixture; scripted mock model
R01.evidence: R01 record in rcd-s1c-core-regression-2026-10-16.json: local discovery ran before Web proposal; invocation succeeded; one loopback request; fixture fact returned.

R02.executionLayer: Harness Execute + built-in web_search + paired loopback fixture control
R02.evidence: R02 record in rcd-s1c-core-regression-2026-10-16.json; denied call refused at admission with tool_not_admitted and no outbound request.

R03.evidence: Synthetic credential, local private path, and explicitly marked private file/Memory queries are blocked before WebRetrievalRuntime.search under sensitiveQueryPolicy=deny.
R03.limitation: Unmarked private free text paraphrased into a generic public query has no trusted taint/provenance signal and is not guaranteed detectable.

R04.evidence: strictReadApproval test observes zero provider calls before approval and one bounded call after explicit approval.

R05.evidence: Built-in results are externalUntrusted; Web/model outputs are not inputs to the trusted user-message network-denial latch. Retrieval-intent tests cover quoted hostile text as non-user intent.
R05.limitation: No real model prompt-injection exercise or Electron acceptance.

R06.evidence: Injected Web transport failure returns stable error and none/partial evidence without success; no auto retry.

R07.evidence: Aborted invocation signal reaches Web request and returns web_fetch_cancelled with no retry; Web Runtime parent-run cancellation tests passed.

R08.evidence: Stable model catalog; dynamic execution is restricted to built-in Web; disabled policy and explicit tool scopes prevent execution.

environment.network: loopback-only local fixture; no public network requests

remaining: Implement trusted data provenance or a stronger approval contract for arbitrary private free text before claiming general exfiltration prevention.

Verify in-flight policy revocation behavior in real Electron; currently run cancellation aborts active requests, while a newly appended offline instruction blocks later requests at the next safe boundary.
Run real Provider and Electron acceptance separately; no such claim is made here.
